answer: The umber register is checked at draw time, spiral lists the eligible set, and marble seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 53 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 53 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 5 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
